$comment: Verified brand social-handle registry (ticket #3732, instagram-campaigns.md section 8). Keys are exact Shopify vendor strings. A handle appears here ONLY when verified: the brand's own site links to the account, or the account and the brand's other official profiles cross-link. Unverifiable vendors carry explicit nulls, never a guess: a wrong tag is worse than no tag. Maker tagging (Brand Crush, Featured Brand of the Week) may cite only non-null entries. Note: an IG @mention today is caption text only (notifies, does not tag); real user_tags plumbing in the publisher is a separate follow-up. Validated by scripts/check-brand-handles.ts.
